translator_notes: Dabilja is a place name. 'Правo си тегле' is my reading ('is heading straight'); it is dialect. Each line is sung twice. Origin unclear, looks traditional.

words_to_learn.en: estate, farm held by an aga

lines.en: He is heading straight for the estate,
he is heading straight for the estate.
When the estate peasants saw him,
when the estate peasants saw him,
they all stood up for him,
they all stood up for him.

lines.cyr: Само Џафер ага не му стана,
lines.lat: Samo Džafer aga ne mu stana,
lines.en: Only Dzhafer Aga did not stand up,

lines.lat: samo Džafer aga ne mu stana.
lines.en: only Dzhafer Aga did not stand up.
So he grew fiercely angry at him,
so he grew fiercely angry at him.

lines.cyr: Кога ќе ми дојдеш на лето в полето,
